*Background*

HelpWear is an exciting clinical-stage startup who is pioneering a new type of heart monitoring system that will identify patients who are at a high risk of suffering a massively debilitating event such as a stroke or syncopal episode (faint/fall due to loss of consciousness). Many of these patients only have random and sporadic cardiac abnormalities, so we are developing the first device that can be comfortably worn as long as needed to ensure that the next actionable event is recorded. After being placed on the patient's upper arm, the HeartWatch continuously records medical-grade electrocardiogram (ECG) signals that give doctors the information they need to make the best treatment decisions to protect their patients. HelpWear was founded out of (and is still based in) St. Michael?s Hospital in Toronto, Ontario and has a second office based in the University of Calgary?s Life Science Innovation Hub. We?re currently a team of ~25 and are looking to find more talented individuals who share our passion for improving patient lives!

*Job Description*

The HeartWatch is a continuous, clinical-grade ECG monitor worn on a patient?s arm to enable the prevention and treatment of heart-related illness. In addition to novel hardware, the HeartWatch has several interconnected software systems: a smartphone app, desktop software, and cloud computing system to collect, store and transfer information to patient?s healthcare providers. As HelpWear?s Full-Stack Developer you will be responsible for managing the AWS cloud infrastructure as the HeartWatch product is rolled out to customers. You will be reporting to the VP of Engineering. You will be responsible for:

* Develop and maintain AWS infrastructure with Terraform.
* Develop and maintain Django backend services.
* Develop and maintain a ML-based data analysis pipeline which can ingest and process large volumes of ECG data.
* Improve the reliability of, scalability of, and the ability to monitor backend services.
* Reduce infrastructure costs.
* Develop and oversee the execution of cybersecurity processes.
* Work alongside a designer to create new features, and oversee the development of the React frontend web application.
* Oversee the development of the Python Qt application used to review ECG data and generate a customer facing summary report.
* Plan projects, anticipate potential risks, and provide timeline estimates.
* Collaborate with the business teams (including the CEO) to develop system requirements for the HeartWatch.
* Work in a team of enthusiastic developers keen on growing their knowledge.

*Requirements*

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of work experience, ideally on a medical device/software that has gone to be approved for use in the US or Canada.
* Proficient in Python and JavaScript.
* Significant experience with AWS or a similar cloud service provider.
* Experience leading complex technical projects.
* Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
* An excellent team player who can work efficiently with minimal supervision.
* Must be based in Toronto.

*Preferences*

* Experience with Django or a similar Python web framework.
* Experience with React or a similar JavaScript framework.
* Experience with Qt or a similar application-development framework.
* Experience with Docker.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or any major RDBMS.
* Experience with Terraform or a similar infrastructure-as-code tool.
* Experience developing and/or maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with cybersecurity (e.g., NIST SP 800, FDA).
* Experience working with time series data at scale (e.g., IoT).

Lead Data Engineer

Who we are 

We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues. We do that by knowing fans best. We work with clients to help them understand & influence what their fans are doing ? the way fans spend their money, the events that fans attend, the channels fans respond to, the content fans watch and more. And we use the understanding this gives us to help our clients grow. Grow their audiences and grow their revenues - both direct to consumer and business to business revenues. Our platforms and services are trusted by over 900 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are almost 1000 people, based out of 14 offices, and we deliver work for sports and entertainment businesses of all shapes and sizes all over the world. 

What You Will Do 

We?re looking for a Lead Data Engineer to join our team of 100+ Data & BI Engineers, building our Audience Intelligence Platform and Helix data products?powering data-driven decision-making across the global sports and entertainment industry. 

Helix is our customer data platform (CDP) and master data management (MDM) solution, enabling organizations to unify fan data, create golden records, and drive personalized engagement through segmentation and insights. 

This is a hands-on technical individual contributor role where you will design, build, and scale data integration capabilities using Scala, distributed data processing (Spark), and AWS technologies. You?ll own delivery end-to-end while mentoring engineers and shaping how data flows into and across the Helix platform. 

You will play a key role in developing reusable, extensible data integration frameworks that enable rapid onboarding of new data sources and ensure reliable, scalable data pipelines. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of Helix data engineering and integration projects?from design through to deployment, monitoring, and production support   
  • Build and operate scalable data ingestion and processing pipelines using AWS services (e.g., S3, EMR/Spark, ECS, Lambda)  
  • Develop and maintain data workflows that support customer identity resolution, fan segmentation, and golden record creation  
  • Work with data storage and warehouse technologies such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, and S3-based data lakes  
  • Design, implement, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale structured and semi-structured data  
  • Define and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, testing, CI/CD, and deployment processes  
  • Troubleshoot complex data and system issues, ensuring high reliability, performance, and scalability  
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to deliver high-impact data solutions aligned to business needs  
  • Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical leadership, supporting their growth and delivery capability  
  • Continuously improve the Helix platform with a focus on reusability, observability, scalability, and maintainability  

Requirements

Requirements 

Core Experience 

  • Strong experience in data engineering, with a focus on data ingestion, integration systems, and large-scale data processing  
  • Experience working with distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark

*About ALPHA IT*

ALPHA IT is one of Vancouver Island?s fastest-growing MSPs, supporting municipalities, First Nations, and small to mid-sized businesses with reliable, secure, and practical IT solutions.

*Position Overview*

This role is primarily focused on network and infrastructure project delivery, designing, deploying, and improving client environments.

You will lead and execute projects such as network builds, firewall upgrades, VoIP deployments, and connectivity solutions (e.g., site-to-site VPNs, wireless solutions, and Starlink deployments).

In addition to project work, you will occasionally support escalations, tickets, and help desk operations, especially for complex networking and infrastructure issues.

This role also requires the ability to train end users and client staff, particularly during projects such as VoIP deployments, where clear guidance and adoption support are critical.

This is a hands-on role that requires strong technical skills, ownership of outcomes, and clear communication with both clients and internal teams.

*What You?ll Do*

* Lead network and infrastructure projects (firewalls, switches, VPNs, wireless)
* Deploy and support VoIP systems
* Build and improve client networks (VLANs, routing, security, connectivity)
* Deliver end-user training during projects (especially VoIP rollouts)
* Support escalations and assist with tickets when required
* Work onsite and remotely across client environments
* Document work clearly and follow best practices

*What We?re Looking For*

* Strong networking experience (firewalls, routing, VPNs, wireless)
* Experience with VoIP systems
* Comfortable leading projects independently
* Able to explain technical solutions and train clients/end users
* Willing to travel to client sites when required (~25%)
* MSP experience preferred

*Requirements*

* 5+ years IT experience
* 3+ years in an MSP environment (preferred)

*Assets*

* Server administration experience (Windows Server, AD, DNS, DHCP)
* Microsoft 365 experience (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, etc.)
* Certifications CCNA, CompTIA Network+ / Security+, SonicWall or firewall certifications, Microsoft (Azure / Security / Identity)
* Experience with municipalities or First Nations communities is an asset

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: $70,000.00-$80,000.00 per year

Benefits:
* Dental care
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On-site parking
* Paid time off
* Vision care

* Courtenay, BC: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

* Please outline the IT project deployment that you are most proud of. 

Experience:
* IT support: 5 years (required)
* MSP: 3 years (required)

* Courtenay, BC (required)

* 25% (required)

Job Description

L3 Network/ Linux Systems Engineer

Responsibilities

  • Being escalation point for a variety of change requests/complex issues
  • Configuration and administration of core routers, switches, firewalls and Linux servers
  • Architecture and designing the network topologies & comprehensive IT solutions, create and maintain Visio / Lucidchart diagrams, configuration templates, IP addressing (NetBox IPAM) and the low-level design documents that contains all the switching/routing details, migration steps, bandwidth analysis and security policy controls
  • Write and implements scripts to automate tasks in Linux (Python/Bash/PHP)
  • Manage various virtualization environments (Proxmox)
  • Utilize the network monitoring tools to pinpoint issues and bottlenecks in the network and take the necessary steps to rectify it.
  • Collaborate with various internal groups, business units to understand the applications and provide end to end network solution as per the firm's network standards.
  • Troubleshoot issues from L2 to L4 of the OSI layer in the network.
  • Configure and route multicast traffic across the network (PIM, IGMP).
  • Building, installing and mounting servers and network equipment's in the DataCenter
  • Troubleshooting server hardware and deep tuning of Linux OS settings to achieve required perfomance
  • Provide break down of an issue to NOC supervisors to enable them understand and explain the problem to the client.

Qualification:

• Expert in classless and classful IPv4 address designing, deploying and management.

  • In-depth knowledge on Routing, Switching and Network Security with the broad industry experience (OSPF, BGP, PIM) on Cisco; Brocade as a plus.

• 3-5 years of experience with designing and implementing large enterprise network environments and with Linux system administration. CCNP or equivalent or higher industry certification are preferred

• Hands on experience with Cisco Catalyst 6500 platform, Nexus (3K,5K,9K) switches, TNSR routing platfrom and PFsense firewalls.

  • Thorough understanding of TCP/IP protocol family and network security technologies.
  • Designed and built a multi-tier DMZ Network with micro and macro segmentation
  • Experience in migrating large scale datacenters and providing the support for the applications migrations.
  • Ability to work both independently and as a team member is essential.
  • Strong presentation skills are imperative to be able to explain network design, articulate risk and facilitate decision making.
  • Experience in network data analysis with tools such as Wireshark, TCPDump
  • Experience in performing administrative tasks on Linux Servers (CentOS and Ubuntu)

• Hands on experience with Cisco network equipment.

• Experienced in configuring multicast nodes and routing multicast traffic across the network

• Hands on experience with PFsense firewall.

• Thorough knowledge of server level operations and software principles utilizing Linux CLI.

• Hands on experience on building, operating and troubleshoot virtual private server (VPS)

• Able to work extra hours if and when required (Maintenance activities and emergencies).

• Sufficient knowledge of python/bash/php to be able to read and modify existing automation scripts, as well as write new ones

Nice to have:

*Knowledge of video transport protocols IP MPEG-TS, HLS, SRT and video standards

*Experience working with GPU/ASIC video processing hardware acceleration

*Ability to understand existing and create gstreamer/ffmpeg pipelines for use in lab environment

*About Us*

Daanaa is a Vancouver-based fabless power electronics and semiconductor company on a mission to build a simpler, efficient future in energy generation, storage, distribution, consumption, and management, for generations ahead. The company is in the early commercialization stages of deep tech power conversion and control technologies, offering innovative solutions to OEMs in multiple industries, including solar energy, electric vehicles, and data centers.

Daanaa's value is derived from its transformative Power Transaction Unit (PTU) that consolidates power electronic functions?from bi-directional conversion and amplification to management, transfer, diagnostics, and control?onto a single, high-power-density, high-efficiency, low-profile, scalable, reliable, and safe module. At Daanaa, we are building a world of Energy Untethered?

We are growing here at Daanaa and we?re looking to add a Test Engineer to join our team to help develop robust test infrastructure, validate performance, and ensure the quality and reliability of our power electronic systems. At Daanaa, you will be joining a team of talented and driven engineers determined to make the world a better place through our revolutionizing power electronic technology.

*What you?ll be doing:*

* *Test Stand Development:* Design, source, build, and commission power test stands for power electronic products. Ensure test infrastructure meets functional and performance validation requirements across development and production volumes.
* *Test Plan Implementation:* Collaborate with hardware and firmware teams to validate and execute test plans. Ensure test systems are designed to support scalable testing?from early prototypes (10s of units) to production volumes (1000s of units).
* *Data Integrity & Automation:* Develop automated test workflows and ensure all test data is captured, stored, and organized in a structured, accurate, and traceable manner, including metadata and test conditions.
* *Circuit Testing & Validation:* Execute test plans to validate functionality, performance, and quality of power electronic, analog, and mixed-signal circuits, with support from senior electrical engineers.
* *Debugging & Root Cause Analysis:* Diagnose and troubleshoot complex system and circuit-level issues, leveraging data to identify root causes and drive resolution.
* *Documentation & Collaboration:* Produce detailed technical documentation and effectively communicate design decisions, trade-offs, and results with cross-functional teams.

*You should apply if?*

* You have 3?6+ years of experience in test engineering, preferably within power electronics or mixed-signal systems
* You have hands-on experience designing and building test systems or test infrastructure
* You have experience executing and validating test plans in collaboration with hardware and/or firmware teams
* You have strong experience testing power electronics, analog, or mixed-signal circuits
* You are proficient with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power analyzers, multimeters, and electronic loads
* You have experience with test automation, scripting (e.g., Python, LabVIEW, or similar), and data acquisition systems
* You understand data integrity principles and can design systems for reliable, structured data capture and storage

The environment is modern and highly focused on APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native technologies. The team works on critical large-scale platforms leveraging Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Azure/GCP, as well as several DevOps and observability tools.

We are looking for an autonomous and versatile professional who is passionate about modern backend development, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and scalable platform engineering.

Trevor Frances Recruitment is supporting a client in the search for a Senior Full Stack Developer. This role is suited for an experienced developer who brings strong technical expertise across both front-end and back-end development, along with the ability to design and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing SaaS solutions.

The position combines hands-on development with architectural thinking, collaboration across cross-functional teams, and contribution to technical strategy. The successful candidate will play a key role in building and evolving modern applications, translating complex requirements into intuitive, maintainable solutions.

*Job Duties*

* Lead the full software development lifecycle, including design, architecture, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance
* Design and develop scalable, secure, and high-performing full-stack applications
* Build and maintain responsive, accessible, and user-focused front-end interfaces
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and backend services using modern frameworks and best practices
* Develop and optimize database structures, queries, and performance within SQL Server environments
* Establish and maintain architecture standards, reusable components, and development best practices
* Leverage cloud technologies to deploy, monitor, and scale applications in a reliable and secure manner
* Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Contribute to sprint planning, technical decision-making, and overall product development strategy
* Partner with QA and DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability practices
* Conduct research and evaluation of emerging technologies, tools, and AI capabilities
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to technical standards across teams
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to other developers as needed

*Requirements*

* Bachelor?s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* 7+ years of professional experience in software development, including full-stack application design and delivery
* Strong experience with modern front-end technologies (e.g., Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS)
* Extensive backend development experience using C# and .NET frameworks
* Solid experience working with SQL Server, including schema design, querying, and performance optimization
* Strong understanding of software design principles, design patterns, and modular architecture
* Experience working with cloud platforms and services, including application deployment and scaling
* Familiarity with modern architectural approaches such as microservices, event-driven systems, or distributed applications
* Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments with cross-functional teams
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to mentor and support team members in a technical capacity
* Experience working in regulated environments, including considerations related to risk, compliance, or audit
* Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and test-driven development (TDD)
* *Exposure to financial services or similar industries is considered an asset*

Trevor Frances Recruitment is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and will work with candidates to accommodate any accessibility needs throughout the hiring process.

  • 35 hours/week

About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: Data Engineering Expert
Type: Contract
Compensation: $90?$125/hour
Location: Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Build long-horizon pipeline tasks with deterministic rubrics to grade agent performance against verifiable ground truth.
  • Develop ETL/ELT pipelines and dbt models to produce specified output tables with incremental logic and defined watermark behavior.
  • Create Airflow/Dagster DAGs that pass test suites and data quality tests with known pass/fail cases.
  • Design warehouse schemas matching defined contracts and performance targets tied to measured query-time budgets.
  • Work independently in long focus sessions to create challenging scenarios for agent evaluation.
  • Ensure tasks have checkable answers without open-ended essays or subjective judgment calls.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • BS or MS in CS or related field.
  • 3+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering.
  • Expertise in dbt model development, pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect), warehouse design (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), and data quality and testing.
  • Comfortable with data engineering artifacts: dbt models, DAGs, schema docs, data contracts, and test suites.
  • Clear written communication skills to articulate reasoning and encode it into deterministic rubrics.

Compensation & Legal

  • Hourly contractor
  • Strong contributors are promoted based on task quality and throughput.

Application Process (Takes 20?30 mins to complete)

  • Upload resume
  • AI interview based on your resume
  • Submit form

Resources & Support

  • For details about the interview process and platform information, please check: https://talent.docs.mercor.com/welcome
  • For any help or support, reach out to: support@mercor.com

The Patry Group of Companies is a diversified, family-owned organization based in Kingston, Ontario, with operations spanning construction and development, residential and commercial property management, and luxury hospitality properties. As we continue to grow across these complementary lines of business, we?re investing in marketing as a strategic function that supports each brand under our umbrella.

We?re hiring a technically strong, AI-fluent Marketing Specialist to lead the day-to-day execution of marketing across our group of companies. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable inside Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, and a CRM as they are in Canva, the Adobe Suite, or an AI assistant. * *LinkedIn Campaign Manager: *run B2B campaigns to support commercial property, construction, and partnership initiatives.
* *Tracking & attribution: *configure and maintain Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, and conversion events; ensure clean data flows between properties, ads, and CRM.

* Report on ROI, cost-per-lead, and cost-per-acquisition by division (construction, property management, hospitality), and recommend where to shift spend.
* Monitor SEO performance across our web properties and Google Business Profile listings, and recommend improvements based on data.

*AI-Driven Marketing (Required)*

_AI is a core part of how we work. You will be expected to research, test, and use AI tools every day to do better work, faster._

* Research ? stay on top of new AI tools, models, and use cases relevant to marketing, design, and analytics; bring forward what?s worth adopting.
* Test ? pilot new AI tools and workflows in real campaigns, measure the impact on output quality and turnaround, and decide what stays.
* Use daily ? work fluently with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and similar tools for content drafting, ad copy, research, audience analysis, briefs, and reporting.
* Use AI design tools (e.g., Canva Magic Studio, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney) to accelerate visual production while protecting brand quality.
* Build and refine prompt libraries, templates, and repeatable AI workflows for the marketing function.
* Experience with marketing automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar) to connect tools, automate reporting, and reduce manual work is strongly preferred.

Company: Project X Ltd.  Employment Type: Contractor Location: Toronto, Ontario (Hybrid working model) Hourly Rate: $80.00-$85.00 Hourly About Project X  Project X Ltd.

drives success by focusing on building teams of incredibly talented and client-focused people, who love to problem solve and work on tough data problems.

We reward hard work and forward-thinking with recognition and a supportive culture that celebrates success and wants to see you grow.  Our team members are trusted advisors to our clients and offer innovative solutions that solve complex data problems.

Collaboration, creativity, data knowledge and experience run deep in our veins.

We are passionate about building long-term relationships with our clients and staying true to our values.

When adding new members to our team, we also look for people that are aligned to our values.  We are also passionate about our people.

Hiring and developing people that seek challenges, like to jump in and learn new things, and are happy to lend a helping hand to a peer is what makes us successful.   We understand that it’s our people that make us great.

  •    Role Summary  We are hiring a Unity Developer to support the implementation of a Proof of Concept (PoC) project with a Tier 1 telecom client.

    This initiative will bring to life a mobile AR-enabled inspection application that allows store managers to capture structured video walkthroughs.

    The video and metadata are then processed for AI-based compliance scoring.    The successful candidate will join our Innovation & Data team at Project X Ltd.

    to build the Unity front end, enabling device camera capture, tagging of in-video events, and integration with downstream processing engines.     Major Areas of Responsibility  Design and develop a Unity-based mobile application (iOS and Android) to support AR-guided video capture workflows.  Integrate device camera APIs to capture continuous walkthrough video footage.  Implement on-screen tagging functionality that timestamps and geolocates user taps/touches.  Ensure local video storage with reliable handoff to backend processing (via REST API or storage pass-through).  Work closely with the Project X team and client-side developers to ensure seamless integration.  Participate in technical design sessions and sprint stand-ups as part of a collaborative, agile delivery environment.  Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Other  3+ years of experience developing Unity applications for mobile (AR experience preferred).  Experience with Unity video capture plugins and custom mobile UI development.  Solid understanding of device hardware access (camera, file system).  Familiarity with metadata tagging, geolocation services, and file export mechanisms.  Comfortable working in a PoC/rapid iteration context with weekly deliverables and feedback loops.  Experience in secure authentication flows (ideally integrating with enterprise SSO).  Ability to read technical architecture documents and align code structure accordingly.  Nice to Have:  Prior exposure to enterprise applications or integrations with AI/ML backend services.  Experience with augmented reality features in Unity (e.g., guiding users through physical spaces).  Familiarity with RESTful APIs, JSON metadata structures, and file handling between front end and backend systems.  Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment   Project X may use automated or AI-enabled tools as part of the recruitment and selection process.

    These tools may support activities such as resume screening, candidate matching, or application management.

*Company Overview*

MDT Sporting Goods Ltd. (MDT) is the market leader in bolt action rifle chassis and accessories. Our products are used worldwide by firearm enthusiasts, manufacturers and law enforcement agencies for accuracy, quality, and reliability. At MDT, we pride ourselves on working hard, enjoying what we do, and exceeding our customers? expectations. With a focus on being legendary, we are looking for top talent and people who are excited and passionate to work in this industry to enhance our customers' experience.
*Summary*

This is a hands-on full-stack development position. You'll build and maintain internal business applications, integrations, and tools that directly support our operations. We're not a software company, but we depend heavily on the systems we build and maintain. The developer we are looking for will work directly on the tools that run our business. You'll work closely with our existing Full Stack Developer and Business Systems Developer and coordinate regularly with the Support team.

*Responsibilities*

* ERP integrations and data workflow (Experience with any mid-market ERP is an asset)
* REST API development and third-party system integrations
* Front-end interfaces for internal teams: Dashboards, reporting tools, workflow UIs
* Automation that reduces manual work across departments
* Internal business applications: Building, maintaining, and improving tools that support operations

*Qualifications*

* Proven full-stack development experience
* Solid SQL skills and comfortable with relational databases
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs
* Proficiency with version control (Git)
* Strong with both backend and frontend
* Clear communicator, you can explain what you built and why to people who aren?t developers

*Who You Are:*

* Takes ownership of your responsibilities: you don't wait to be told something is broken
* Works independently, managing your own priorities and flagging blockers early
* Passionate about the work you do and wants everything done in a legendary fashion
* Eager to grow: new tools, new problems, and new domains don't intimidate you
* Leaves things better than you found them

*Nice to Have:*

* Experience with ERP systems in a manufacturing or distribution environment (Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP B1, Epicor, or similar)
* Familiarity with manufacturing operations concepts: BOMs, inventory, work orders, purchasing
* Experience working in a small IT or development team where roles overlap
* Comfort with AI-assisted development tools (you know how to use them well, not just lean on them)
* PHP, React, TypeScript, or Node.js experience

This is an excellent opportunity if you are looking for a place to grow, put down roots, and do work that matters to the people around you. If this sounds like something you are looking for, we would like to hear from you! Please submit your resume and a note about what you've built.

Pay: $70,000.00-$90,000.00 per year

Benefits:
* Casual dress
* Company events
* Dental care
* Extended health care
* Paid time off
* RRSP match
* Vision care

* Please write a short note about what you've built. Something that you are proud of and the type of work that you want and enjoy doing.
* Do you have any experience with the ERP system Acumatica?
* What type of AI-assisted development tools have you used, and what have you used them for?

Who we are:

Founded in 2010, Semios Group is a leading agricultural technology company helping growers, agronomists, and ag retailers manage over 200 million acres across five countries. Semios pioneered variable-rate pheromone-based mating disruption in orchards and has since expanded into a comprehensive portfolio covering crop protection, water management, frost control, automation, and a leading farm management information system. The Semios Group includes trusted brands such as Semios, Agworld, Altrac, and Greenbook. We continue to drive the next generation of digital agriculture, supporting growers, agronomists and ag retailers in improving sustainability and profitability.

Our innovative work has been recognized with several industry awards, including:

  • AgTech Breakthrough ? Smart Irrigation Company & Pest Management Solution of the Year
  • Thrive Top 50
  • Google for Startups Accelerator Cohort
  • Global Cleantech Top 100

We know our journey is only achievable by having a great team who shares ideas, tries new things, and learns as we go.

Who you are:

You?re driven by purpose and motivated by work that matters. You?re looking for more than a role, you want to be part of a growing, forward-thinking company solving real-world challenges to improve how farming works, today and for the future. 

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will play a key role in ensuring the scalability, reliability, and performance of our infrastructure and services. Operating within a high-performing engineering team, this role bridges the gap between development and operations, with a strong focus on automation, observability, and resilience. You will use your technical expertise and leadership skills to drive improvements across systems and processes, ensuring we deliver high-quality, reliable products to our customers. This is a hands-on role where your impact will be felt across both technical execution and team development. You will be part of a team operating across time zones and global regions.

*Backend Software Engineer (Remote ? Canada)*

CreditBook is a Canadian fintech SaaS company building mission-critical lending and credit systems. We're looking for a Backend Software Engineer to own service development primarily in TypeScript on serverless AWS, take ownership of our infrastructure-as-code, and help drive the serverless migration that's reshaping our platform.

This is not a pure cloud role and it's not a pure application role ? it's the engineer who is comfortable shipping a TypeScript service on Lambda, writing the Serverless Framework config that deploys it, and dropping into the C# codebase when the work calls for it.

*What You'll Do*

* Build and maintain backend services primarily in *TypeScript / Node.js* on AWS Lambda.
* Own infrastructure-as-code in *Serverless Framework* and *Terraform* ? write it, review it, and raise the bar across the team.
* Read, extend, and occasionally write *C# / .NET* code on our existing Sloan platform, including porting logic forward into TypeScript as part of the serverless migration.
* Drive the serverless migration on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, S3, EventBridge).
* Tighten our CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines) and our deployment safety story.
* Carry light SRE responsibility: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and post-mortems on the systems you ship.
* Participate actively in PR reviews and uphold our quality bar (tests, security, performance).
* Work fluently with AI coding tools as part of your daily development practice.

*Tech & Environment*

* TypeScript / Node.js, C# / .NET, SQL Server, Postgres
* AWS (Lambda, ECS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch)
* Serverless Framework and Terraform for IaC (CloudFormation in one product line)
* Bitbucket Pipelines, Snyk, SonarQube, Rovo Dev (AI-enforced PR review)
* SOC2 / security-minded development in a fintech context

*What We're Looking For*

* 4+ years of backend engineering experience shipping production services.
* Strong *TypeScript / Node.js*. You've built and operated production services in it.
* Comfortable reading *C# / .NET* and willing to write it when the work calls for it.
* Hands-on experience with *Serverless Framework* and *Terraform* on AWS. You've owned modules and stacks, not just edited them.
* Comfort with serverless architecture (Lambda, event-driven patterns) and SQL performance.
* Working familiarity with SRE practice ? observability, SLIs/SLOs, incident response.
* Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as a daily practice, not a curiosity.
* Direct communicator. Comfortable being accountable for what you ship.

*Nice to Have*

* Experience with monitoring tools (Datadog, Grafana)
* Familiarity with microservices architecture
* Exposure to CloudFormation.
* Experience leading a cloud or serverless migration.
* Fintech, lending, or payments experience.
* SOC2 or other compliance-driven environments.

*Why This Role Matters*

You'll be the engineer who owns the seam between our application code and the infrastructure it runs on, during the period when we're moving that infrastructure to serverless and consolidating it under Terraform. The work you do will directly shape how reliable, secure, and acquirer-ready our platform looks 12 months from now.

Pay: $80,000.00-$120,000.00 per year

* Paid time off
* Wellness program
* Work from home

* TypeScript: 3 years (required)
* AWS: 3 years (required)

Our tools: Empower patients to share health information with their physician before, during, and after visits, helping to ensure health records are up to-date and accurate while improving patient care.

Meet the growing demand for digital solutions with online booking and secure messaging that improves the patient’s experience, reduces the need for unnecessary phone calls, and makes clinics more efficient.  Improve access to care by replacing faxes, displaying wait times, and reducing the time to process and access specialist referrals.  Who we need Reporting to the Senior Director, Cloud Operations and Security, we are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our cloud engineering and security-focused team to help design, build, and operate scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure on AWS.

At Canadian Forces Morale and Welfare Services (CFMWS), we?re more than just a workplace; we?re a proud community dedicated to supporting Canadian Armed Forces members, veterans and their families in their daily lives. We carefully curate and provide programs and services designed to meet their unique needs and enhance their mental, social, physical, financial and familial well-being. CFMWS employees deliver programs and services including recreation, sports and fitness programs, customized financial services, retail services, access to retail savings and discounts and offers family support and organizes charity events.

Our success stems from living our values. Our employees care about their role in supporting Canadian Armed Forces members, veterans and their families and act with integrity in all they do. Thriving in our close-knit environment, we act as one team with one mission. We constantly seek new ideas and creative ways to deliver the best possible programs and services.

As an employer, we offer a commitment to your health, wellness and growth. We provide a diverse range of roles across many locations and a career where you can make a meaningful impact.

THE ROLE

Under the direction of the Director, IM/IT Business Services, the National Manager, IM/IT Project Management Office (PMO) manages IM/IT projects and programs management services such as project analysis, project execution, and project delivery for the Organization. She/he ensures investments and initiatives in project management services are aligned with business strategies and priorities. The National Manager, IM/IT Project Management Office directs and manages the delivery of IT projects within the PMO portfolio. She/he collaborates with business and technology Subject Matter Experts (SME), business unit leaders, and managers to develop and manage project and program budgeting and cost estimation approaches, resource allocation and reallocations. She/he reviews budget proposals and makes recommendation for subsequent budget changes where necessary.

QUALIFICATIONS NEEDED

Education, Certifications and Licenses

College diploma or certificate in Business Administration, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics or a related field, AND several years of experience in project management or a related field.

Experience

In developing and implementing PMO strategies

In establishing PMO framework, policies and procedures

In PMO process and performance modeling, benchmarking and analysis

In project/portfolio resource planning, reporting, prioritization and budgeting

In leading and managing IM/IT projects and programs

In managing the work of contractor and/or services providers

In delivering distributed systems

In project portfolio management

In project scope and change management

In vendor management

In risk management

In issue management

In project audit

In business analysis

In Request for Proposal development

In IM/IT contracts

In software development and delivery

In databases and networking

In software integration

In budget administration

In personnel administration

In CA Clarity Project and Portfolio Management (PPM) system, an asset

In Customer Relation Management (CRM) systems, an asset.

*Construction Project Manager*

Superior Projects is a growing general contracting company with lots of energy and passion for the next challenge. We love what we do and are proud to deliver on all our construction projects. Our genuine care and construction made simple mantra is the foundation for how we operate.

We are currently seeking a reliable and hardworking Project Manager to join our team. Project locations range from Southeastern Manitoba to Winnipeg and the surrounding area. If you are motivated, have a strong work ethic, and are looking to gain experience in the construction industry, we want to hear from you!

*About the Opportunity:*

The Project Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of construction projects, from planning and budgeting to execution and completion. They coordinate with stakeholders, ensure projects adhere to safety regulations and timelines, and maintain quality standards. This role requires strong leadership, problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.

*Job Summary & Key Responsibilities:*

* Oversee all stages of construction projects, from planning and permitting through to execution and final inspection, ensuring timely completion within budget constraints
* Collaborate with stakeholders, clients, subcontractors, and internal teams to maintain clear communication, set realistic expectations, and ensure seamless project delivery
* Manage scheduling, documentation, budgeting, and on-site supervision, optimizing resource allocation and ensuring strict adherence to project timelines
* Maintain high standards of safety, quality, and craftsmanship by conducting regular site inspections and enforcing best practices
* Proactively identify and address project issues, adapting to changes and keeping progress on track
* Guide and support team members, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and high-performance work environment

*Qualifications & Requirements:*

* Excellent verbal and written communication
* 5+ years experience in construction project management with comprehensive knowledge of building science, general contracting, codes, and construction best practices
* Preference will be given to applicants with an education in construction project management or engineering
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and confident
* Demonstrates critical thinking and problem-solving
* Team-oriented mindset
* Calm, composed and works well under pressure
* Looking for a long-term career opportunity
* Time management and multi-tasking abilities
* Proficient in Microsoft Office software?s, and MS Project or equivalent

*Benefits & Perks:*

* Competitive wages based on experience and performance
* Comprehensive health benefits plan
* RRSP matching plan
* Performance Incentive Plan
* Ongoing education and training are encouraged and provided
* Career growth opportunities
* A stable work-life balance that values flexibility
* A supportive and friendly team environment
* A positive and fun corporate culture: company events

*Project Manager - Construction*

*Location:* Toronto, Ontario (GTA)
*Type:* Full-time, Permanent

We are currently looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our Major Projects group in the GTA. This role is responsible for overseeing the successful execution of underground and infrastructure construction projects from planning through completion.

The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, clients, subcontractors, and field leadership to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with quality expectations. This is an excellent opportunity for a driven construction professional who thrives in a fast-paced, field-focused environment and enjoys leading complex infrastructure projects.

*What You?ll Be Doing*

* Lead the day-to-day management and execution of Major Projects from initiation through completion
* Develop and monitor project plans, schedules, budgets, forecasts, and project performance metrics
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with contractual requirements
* Coordinate internal teams, subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, and third-party stakeholders
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify and resolve issues impacting schedule, cost, quality, or safety
* Support project planning activities including procurement, resourcing, scheduling, and risk mitigation
* Maintain project documentation including reporting, billing, change management, projections, and progress tracking
* Provide timely project reporting to senior leadership and clients
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, municipalities, consultants, and field operations teams
* Ensure workmanship, materials, and project deliverables meet or exceed company and client expectations
* Support a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with company policies, client requirements, and applicable legislation

*What We?re Looking For*

* Minimum 5 years of experience managing construction or infrastructure projects
* Post-secondary education in Construction Management, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience)
* PMP designation is required
* Valid Ontario driver?s licence and ability to travel throughout the GTA as required
* Strong knowledge of construction project management processes, scheduling, budgeting, and contract administration
* Strong planning, organizational, and execution skills
* Ability to effectively manage timelines, budgets, priorities, and stakeholder expectations
* Excellent communication and relationship-management skills
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
* Ability to perform effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced construction environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and Project

*Nice to Have*

* Familiarity with underground utilities and infrastructure construction
* Experience working in utility construction, civil construction, or related infrastructure sectors
* Experience with scheduling software
* Experience managing unionized construction environments

*Pay Transparency Statement:*
In accordance with Ontario?s Pay Transparency requirements, the expected compensation range for this role is $150,000 ? $155,000 annually, with the potential to offer up to $160,000 for candidates with exceptional experience and qualifications. Compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate?s skills, experience, and overall fit for the role.

*Why Join Us*

* Permanent, full-time opportunity within a growing group
* Opportunity to lead meaningful infrastructure and construction projects across the GTA
* Collaborative and field-focused environment with strong operational support
* Competitive compensation and opportunity for long-term career growth

*Posting Status*

* Working with Preconstruction team in development of project.
* Manage budget and financial reporting, interpret and analyze reports to ensure adherence to project budget.

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive *Marketing Specialist* to join our team for the summer through the Government of Canada?s Canada Summer Jobs program. The ideal candidate will be a skilled communicator with a strong attention to detail, capable of managing multiple priorities. The Marketing Specialist supports the Health Foundation by developing and executing the annual marketing plan, managing day-to-day social media and digital communications, and ensuring consistent brand messaging across all platforms. This role also provides creative and logistical support for signature events and campaigns, collaborates with internal teams and partners to enhance community engagement, and contributes to strategies that strengthen donor awareness and support to effectively advance the foundation's mission. The role additionally will support coordinating logistics for annual events, managing stakeholder communication, and supporting day-to-day tasks, ensuring efficient workflow to enable the team to focus on strategic initiatives and effectively advance the foundation's mission.

This is an in-office, temporary summer position with a competitive salary and flexible working hours. We prioritize a work-life balance that supports your personal and professional goals.

*What We Offer*

* *Mission-Driven Work:* Be a part of a skilled team dedicated to improving health and wellness in the Wood Buffalo community. Your contributions will directly support initiatives that make a real difference.
* *Collaborative Culture:* We foster a collaborative culture that encourages teamwork, open communication, and shared goals.
* *Creative Freedom:* Take ownership of our digital footprint and bring innovative marketing ideas to life in a supportive environment.

*Eligibility*

* Must meet the Canada Summer Jobs program criteria

*Desired Qualifications*

* Minimum 1 year of experience in a marketing, communications, or digital media role.
* Strong organizational, communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in marketing technology, social media management tools, and design software (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite).
* Proven experience (or strong academic portfolio) in content creation, managing digital campaigns, and maintaining brand consistency.
* A bachelor's degree, diploma, or active enrollment in a marketing, communications, digital media, public relations, or a related field is considered an asset.
* Valid Class 5 driver's licence.

*About Us*

Since 1985, the Northern Lights Health Foundation has been dedicated to enhancing healthcare services. Through campaigns, signature events, and various other fundraising initiatives, the foundation funds vital medical equipment, programs, and services, bringing care closer to home for Wood Buffalo residents.

The Northern Lights Health Foundation is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Marketing Specialist supports the growth of Lorex?s B2B business and the Lorex Partner Program by executing marketing campaigns, maintaining B2B website content, supporting partner communications, and assisting with marketing tools and reporting.

This role provides exposure to multiple areas of B2B marketing, including digital campaigns, partner marketing, Martech, competitive monitoring, and content development. The position works closely with sales, marketing, operations, and product teams to support marketing initiatives for installers, dealers, and professional partners.

This role reports to the Director of Marketing and serves as a key driver of B2B business development. Working in tandem with the B2B Channel Marketing Manager, the position ensures integrated marketing efforts across our key business channels for B2B.

*Key Responsibilities*

*B2B Website & Content Management*

* Develop and maintain content on the B2B website (*pro.lorex.com*), including product pages, solution pages, and partner resources.
* Review the website regularly to ensure content is current and aligned with active programs and campaigns.
* Identify outdated content, broken links, or obsolete messaging and coordinate updates with internal teams.
* Write and edit product descriptions, solution pages, and B2B-focused articles.
* Supports as needed to create marketing visuals and digital assets using design tools such as Photoshop or similar platforms.

*Channel & Partner Marketing Support*

* Support marketing initiatives for the Lorex Partner Program and the broader B2B ecosystem.
* Assist with organizing and managing partner segments including:
* Professional Installers
* SMB/E Dealers
* Solutions Partners
* Help identify partner user journeys to support targeted campaigns based on purchase frequency, industry, partner segment, and engagement levels.
* Assist in executing marketing campaigns tailored to specific partner groups.
* Support updates to catalogues, presentations, and marketing materials with partner co-branding.

*CRM & Lifecycle Marketing*

* Build and execute marketing campaigns through email and SMS platforms.
* Support lifecycle marketing campaigns including:
* Onboarding campaigns for new partners
* Engagement campaigns for active partners
* Reactivation campaigns for inactive partners
* Monitor campaign performance and contribute to reporting and campaign optimization.

*Loyalty & Promotional Programs*

* Support implementation and management of the Loyalty program for B2B partners.
* Assist with planning and executing partner promotions and campaign incentives.
* Monitor competitor loyalty programs and promotional strategies to support campaign benchmarking.

*Competitive Monitoring & Market Intelligence*

* Monitor competitor websites and marketplaces to track changes in: product launches, pricing, promotions, and messaging
* Maintain reporting on competitive activity and market trends.

*Social Media & Community Engagement*

* Support development and management of B2B-focused social media content targeting installers, dealers, and professional partners.
* Collaborate with the social media team to develop content that engages the professional security community.

*Lead Generation Tools*

* Support the use of lead generation and prospecting platforms such as: LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Uplead.
* Assist with prospect list development and support campaigns focused on partner acquisition.

*Job Title: Digital Marketing Specialist & IT Systems Consultant (Private Psychology Practice ? GTA)*

*Job Type:* Contract / Freelance (Project-based with ongoing monthly support)

*About Us*

We are a growing private psychology practice based in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). We provide compassionate, evidence-based mental health services. We are looking for a versatile professional to manage our digital growth while ensuring our practice infrastructure is highly secure, efficient, and compliant with Ontario healthcare regulations.

*Role Overview*

This comprehensive role merges *Website Development*, *Local SEO*, *Digital Marketing and IT/Systems Management*. The ideal candidate will build a modern online presence to attract clients while simultaneously managing our back-end technical operations, email security, and practice management software (Jane App)integrations.

*Key Responsibilities*

*Phase 1: IT Infrastructure & Data Security*

* *Compliant Workspace Setup:* Configure and maintain a secure Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 environment tailored for healthcare professionals.
* *Privacy & Encryption:* Ensure all practice email accounts, file storage, and data communications utilize end-to-end encryption.
* *Hardware & Network Support:* Provide basic troubleshooting for local hardware (laptops, printers) and secure router configurations for remote or office environments.
* *Backup & Disaster Recovery:* Implement automatic, secure, encrypted cloud backup solutions for practice files to prevent data loss.

*Phase 2: Website Design, Development & Integration*

* *Design & Build:* Create a secure, modern, mobile-responsive website (WordPress preferred).
* *Practice Software Integration:* Seamlessly connect the website with Canadian-compliant electronic medical record (EMR) software (e.g., Jane App, Owl Practice) for secure scheduling and intake.
* *Secure Web Forms:* Deploy secure, encrypted web contact forms to protect incoming personal health information.

*Phase 3: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & Marketing*

* *Local SEO:* Optimize our Google Business Profile to rank highly in localized searches across the GTA (e.g., "Psychologist in Mississauga", "CBT therapy Toronto").
* *On-Page & Technical SEO:* Optimize website metadata, speed, and mobile usability while executing an ethics-compliant local keyword strategy.
* *Analytics Tracking:* Deploy Google Analytics 4 (GA4) with strict privacy controls to monitor traffic and conversions safely.

*Required Qualifications & Experience*

Vestcor has a full-time position available for a Senior Member Services Analyst.Located in Fredericton, Vestcor is the largest investment manager in Atlantic Canada, providing global investment management services to 11 different client groups representing approximately $24.4 billion in assets under management. We also provide administration services to 11 pension plans and five employee benefit plans.The Senior Member Services Analyst works as part of a team that is responsible for providing timely pension and benefits information to members and employers. They are expected to have a solid understanding of the provisions within the plans that they are responsible for and should also understand the Pensions Benefits Act, the Income Tax Act, and basic concepts within a funding policy and actuarial valuation. Other major responsibilities include preparing and delivering presentations to various client groups and researching, analyzing, and interpreting the provisions of the various pension and employee benefit programs. The work is performed within a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Some travel within New Brunswick will be required.The successful candidate will have experience with pension plans and benefit programs, excellent verbal and written communications skills, analytical skills along with excellent organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, and be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office.The ideal candidate should have a post-secondary degree or diploma and five years' experience in a related field.Written and spoken proficiency in English is required and written and spoken proficiency in French is considered an asset.In the cover letter, candidates must demonstrate why they believe they have the required qualifications and skills for this position. We offer a competitive salary, an excellent benefits package, and a challenging and rewarding team environment. The successful candidate will participate in the New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan.Vestcor supports a diverse and inclusive work environment and encourages applications from all qualified applicants. Interested applicants must forward their cover letter and resume by June 1, 2026 to:Director Human ResourcesVestcor Inc.100 - 140 Carleton St.Fredericton, NB E3B 3T4Or via e-mail to: careers@vestcor.org

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

  • For any help or support, reach out to: support@mercor.com

AI Learning Designer / Instructional Designer ? Remote 

Create impactful AI-driven learning experiences in a fast-paced insurance environment where innovation, creativity, and digital learning come together. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to design engaging microlearning content, leverage cutting-edge AI tools, and influence how global teams learn and apply emerging technologies through modern, learner-focused training solutions.

What is in it for you:

? Salaried: $45-50 per hour.
? Incorporated Business Rate: $55-60 per hour.
? Initial contract duration of 6 months.
? Full-time contract position within the insurance sector.
? Possibility of extension and potential conversion opportunity.
? Day schedule, 37.50 hours per week.
? Enjoy the flexibility of remote work.

Responsibilities:

? Lead end-to-end instructional design using structured methodologies such as ADDIE or SAM, including needs analysis, learning objectives, design strategy, development, implementation support, and evaluation.
? Partner with stakeholders and subject matter experts to translate business needs into effective learning solutions while managing reviews and feedback cycles to achieve project scope and success measures.
? Design and develop learning assets across multiple formats, including Synthesia AI microlearning videos, digital modules, instructor-led materials, and job aids.
? Edit and produce learner-ready video assets, including cuts, captions, audio cleanup, transitions, and branding templates using video editing tools.
? Measure and improve learning effectiveness through evaluation approaches, learner data analysis, and iterative design improvements.
? Create workflow-based enablement and reinforcement materials such as realistic scenarios, practice activities, prompts, job aids, and communities-of-practice resources to support AI skill application in daily work.
? Design localization-ready content for global audiences using plain language, accessible templates, and consistent terminology while supporting translation and localization workflows.
? Ensure quality, accessibility, and consistency by applying learning standards, inclusive design practices, and accessibility guidelines such as WCAG.
? Leverage AI responsibly within the design workflow to support ideation, scripting, and asset creation while aligning with enterprise standards related to privacy, accessibility, risk, branding, and validation.

What you will need to succeed:

? Bachelor?s Degree in Instructional Design, Education, Learning Experience Design, Communications, Business, or a related field.
? 5 years of progressive experience in instructional design or learning experience design within an enterprise environment.
? Demonstrated expertise in instructional design methodologies, including analysis, learning objectives, storyboarding, and assessment design across multiple learning modalities.
? Ability to provide a portfolio or work samples demonstrating instructional design capabilities.
? Strong experience designing enterprise learning solutions using methodologies such as ADDIE or SAM from needs analysis through evaluation.
? Hands-on experience creating learner-ready assets including microlearning videos, digital modules, job aids, presentation decks, and reinforcement materials.
? Working knowledge of AI concepts and generative AI productivity tools.
? Experienced Graphic Designer Wanted - Busy Print Shop

We are a fast-paced and growing print shop looking for a talented and experienced Graphic Designer to join our team. If you are creative, detail-oriented, and thrive in a high-volume environment, we would love to hear from you.

  • Designing and preparing print-ready artwork
  • Communicating with customers regarding artwork and revisions

What We Offer:

  • Fast-paced and creative work environment
  • Opportunity for growth
  • Competitive wage based on experience
  • Full-time position available


If you are motivated, reliable, and passionate about design and print, we encourage you to apply.

Job details
*Overview*
We are seeking a talented and creative Graphic Designer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for visual storytelling and a strong background in digital and print design. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on diverse projects, including UI design, motion graphics, logo creation, and marketing materials. The successful applicant will demonstrate proficiency in industry-standard tools and possess a keen eye for aesthetics, typography, and user experience.

*Responsibilities*

* Develop compelling visual designs for digital platforms, including websites, social media, and marketing campaigns.
* Create engaging motion graphics and animations using Adobe After Effects and other relevant software.
* Design logos, branding elements, and visual assets that align with client or company branding guidelines.
* Produce high-quality print materials such as brochures, flyers, and presentations using Adobe InDesign and CorelDRAW etc.
* Maintain consistency in typography, color schemes, and overall visual style across all projects.
* Present design concepts clearly to stakeholders and incorporate feedback effectively to refine final outputs.

*Qualifications*

* Proven experience in graphic design with a strong portfolio showcasing digital design, branding, and motion graphics work.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Adobe After Effects, Sketch, CorelDRAW, Figma, InVision, HTML/CSS/JavaScript basics, and WordPress.
* Strong understanding of typography principles and visual design best practices.
* Experience with digital marketing campaigns and creating assets optimized for various platforms.
* Excellent presentation skills with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to clients or team members.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Pay: $19.00-$21.00 per hour
